# 華嚴經持驗記

**ID:** X1534
**Volume:** X77
**Category:** 史傳部類
**Original Category:** 史傳部／華嚴宗
**Byline:** 清 周克復纂
**Dynasty:** 清
**Date:** 1644–1911
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X1534

## Contributors
- 周克復 (A000558)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 1-juan early-Qīng anthology of *Avataṃsaka*-cult miracle-narratives, the *Avataṃsaka* component of [周克復](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%91%A8%E5%85%8B%E5%BE%A9)'s coordinated five-text *chí-yàn jì* 持驗記 series. Companion to [KR6r0072](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0072) *Fǎ-huá-jīng chí-yàn jì*, [KR6r0073](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0073) *Guān-yīn-jīng chí-yàn jì*, the *Jīn-gāng-jīng chí-yàn jì* (X87 no. 1635), and the *Jìng-tǔ chén-zhōng* (X62 no. 1172). Composition window c. **1659–1670**.

**Abstract**

The work draws on [KR6r0085](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0085), [KR6r0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0087), [KR6r0088](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0088), and miscellaneous Sòng-Yuán-Míng anecdote material to produce a streamlined chronological compendium of *Avataṃsaka*-cult efficacious-response narratives, organised along the same editorial principles as Zhōu Kèfù's other *chí-yàn jì* — terse prose, accessible register, focus on the miraculous outcome over doctrinal context. The selection moves from the Liù-cháo through the Suí-Táng-Sòng-Yuán-Míng down to the early Qīng, with substantial late-Míng / early-Qīng material new to the *chí-yàn* genre.

The work is the **most compact** of the canonical *Avataṃsaka*-cult anthologies — at 1 juan, considerably shorter than [KR6r0085](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0085)'s 1 juan or even [KR6r0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0087)'s 1 juan — and was designed to circulate as a pocket-format devotional handbook for lay practitioners undertaking *Avataṃsaka* recitation. The text was first printed in the early Qīng under Zhōu's own auspices and was incorporated into the Manji Xuzangjing (X77 no. 1534).
